claims.claim: HiCache maps GPU HBM to L1, Host DRAM to L2 and external storage to L3.
claims.locator: Why and What is HiCache / System Design
claims.notes: Tier names are a conceptual analogy.

claims.claim: L1 and L2 are private to an inference instance; L3 may be shared according to backend configuration.
claims.notes: A node-local file backend is not automatically cluster shared.

claims.claim: HiRadixTree records local KV tier locations and queries the L3 backend for remote metadata.
claims.notes: Local and remote metadata paths are distinct.

claims.claim: HiCache provides best_effort, wait_complete and timeout prefetch termination strategies.
claims.notes: Defaults can change; not frozen as universal.

claims.claim: HiCache supports multiple write-back policies and host memory layouts.
claims.notes: Cost formulas are derived teaching models.
